title: Brazilian footballer arrested in drug trafficking investigation
html:
Brazilian footballer arrested in drug trafficking investigation

Brazilian footballer David Correa da Fonseca was arrested during a Vasco da Gama training session in Rio de Janeiro over alleged links to organised crime, including drug and arms trafficking. He denies involvement.
summary: Brazilian footballer David Correa da Fonseca was arrested during a Vasco da Gama training session in Rio de Janeiro.
